controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Manage system accounts including establishing, activating, modifying, disabling, and removing accounts.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify that IAM accounts are inventoried, reviewed, and access is commensurate with role.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify that access to S3 buckets and other resources is restricted to authorized principals only.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify no IAM entity has permissions beyond their operational requirement.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.description: Identify the types of events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify CloudTrail is enabled in all regions and captures management and data events.

controls.title: Content of Audit Records
controls.description: Ensure audit records contain sufficient information to establish what events occurred, when, where, sources, outcomes, and identities.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify CloudTrail records include user identity, event time, source IP, and affected resource.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.description: Protect audit information and tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify CloudTrail log destination bucket is not publicly accessible and has log file validation enabled.

controls.title: Audit Record Generation
controls.description: Provide audit record generation capability for the list of events defined in AU-2.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify audit logging is active and generating records across all required services and regions.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and processes acting on behalf of organizational users.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify MFA is enforced for all IAM users with console access.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Manage system authenticators by verifying identity, establishing initial content, ensuring sufficient strength, and protecting against unauthorized disclosure or modification, including rotation and revocation.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify access keys and passwords are rotated within policy and that authenticator strength requirements (length, complexity, reuse) are enforced.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication for Non-Organizational Users
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify Cognito identity pools do not grant unauthenticated access to AWS resources.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries; deny network traffic by default and allow by exception.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify security groups, NACLs, and default VPC configurations restrict ingress from the internet and follow deny-by-default for high-risk ports.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of information during transmission.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify EC2 instances enforce IMDSv2 and sensitive data is not transmitted over unencrypted channels.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify S3 buckets have server-side encryption enabled with approved key types.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information system flaws; test software updates before installation.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify Security Hub findings are tracked and remediated within defined timeframes.

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor the system to detect attacks, indicators of potential attacks, and unauthorized connections; identify unauthorized use of the system.
controls.assessment_objective: Verify continuous monitoring services (GuardDuty, Config, Security Hub) are enabled and producing findings across all in-scope regions.
